annotations.title: Change which interviews can use a document

description:
[Knowledge base] Replace the interview limit of an existing knowledge base document. interview_ids is required: a list limits it to those interviews on the same knowledge base, [] to none, and null opens it to every interview on the knowledge base.

Replaces the interview limit of an existing knowledge base document: a list of interviews, an empty list for none, or null for every interview on the knowledge base. Takes effect for the next live session and the next generation; the document is not processed again and costs no credits.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

interview_ids.description: The whole new list, which replaces the old one. A list limits the document to those interviews, an empty list to no interview, and null opens it to every interview on the knowledge base. Required, so that leaving it out can never open a document. Each interview must belong to the same company as the document and use the same knowledge base.

knowledge_base_id.description: The document to change: `knowledge_base_id` from the upload response or from knowledge-base-document-list.

name: set_knowledge_base_document_interviews

interview_ids.description: The interviews this document is limited to. Present only when `limit_to_interviews` is true; an empty list means no interview can use it.

limit_to_interviews.description: True when the document is limited to the interviews in `interview_ids`. False when every interview on the knowledge base can use it.

title: Change which interviews can use a document
